title: EEG-Xplain: Decoding Neural Black-Boxes of EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EEG foundation models such as BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGMamba have achieved remarkable performance in neural signal decoding, but their black-box nature limits clinical trust and neuroscientific validation. We propose a unified attribution framework for interpreting EEG foundation models across heterogeneous architectures. The framework integrates gradient-, perturbation-, and activation-based explanation methods to analyze model behavior in spatial, temporal, and frequency dimensions. Spatially, it identifies critical EEG channels and visualizes their distributions using topographic maps. Temporally, it highlights decision-relevant signal segments through attribution heatmaps. In the frequency domain, it quantifies the contributions of canonical EEG rhythms via spectral perturbation analysis. translated_title: EEG-Xplain：解码EEG基础模型的神经黑箱
translated_abstract: 诸如BIOT、LaBraM和EEGMamba等EEG基础模型在神经信号解码方面取得了卓越的性能，但其黑盒特性限制了临床信任和神经科学验证。我们提出了一个统一的归因框架，用于解释跨异构架构的EEG基础模型。该框架整合了基于梯度、基于扰动和基于激活的解释方法，从空间、时间和频率维度分析模型行为。在空间维度上，它识别关键的EEG通道，并使用脑地形图可视化其分布。在时间维度上，它通过归因热图突出显示与决策相关的信号片段。在频域上，它通过频谱扰动分析量化典型EEG节律的贡献。为评估解释的可靠性，我们引入了一种结合扰动曲线下面积（AOPC）和跨方法一致性的群体级评估方法。
tldr: 提出了一个统一的可解释性框架EEG-Xplain，整合梯度、扰动和激活三类解释方法，从空间、时间和频率三个维度解码EEG基础模型的黑盒决策机制，并通过AOPC和跨方法一致性进行群体级可靠性评估。
en_tdlr: EEG-Xplain is a unified attribution framework that integrates gradient-, perturbation-, and activation-based explanation methods to interpret EEG foundation models across spatial, temporal, and frequency dimensions, with population-level reliability evaluation via AOPC and cross-method consistency.
